description: The figures a choice between places turns on, for two to four destinations at once, in the order of the site's ranking whatever the order asked: totality and its times, lodging (eclipse-week mean, per person, Eclipse Premium, reading day), both ends of the cloud range, heat, access, airport, the cost of the observation, and the entry regime of one passport or of each passport we cover. get_destination has the rest.

destinations.description: Two to four destination keys, as list_destinations returns them.

passport.description: ISO code of the traveller's passport. Without it, one short line per passport we cover.

name: compare_destinations
title: Two to four destinations side by side
